scamper.prompt: Substitute: replace the convention's main object with something from another room of life
Combine: merge the convention with an opposite convention of another category
Adapt: borrow the convention's shape from a ritual, a game or a trade
Modify: change its scale, speed or duration until it becomes strange
Put to other use: let the convention's prop do a different job in the frame
Eliminate: remove the element the convention depends on and film what remains
Reverse: play the convention in the opposite order or from the opposite side

categoryConventions: the product on a clean ground
a person reacting to a screen

contradictions: the film must show the product working, but must not look like a demo
the film must be fast enough for the feed, but must let one moment breathe
the film must explain, but must carry no more than one line of copy
the film must feel personal, but must show no real person or data
the film must show a problem, but must not feel negative
the film must be calm, but must stop a scrolling thumb
the film must show the result, but must keep a reason to watch to the end
the film must show a complex system, but read as one image

separations.prompt: Separate in time: one half of the film is X, the other is not-X; name the frame where it flips
Separate in space: X in one part of the frame, not-X in the other; name what divides them
Separate in scale: X up close, not-X from far away (or the reverse); name the move between them
